first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing directly addresses the competitor-driven loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and is supported by prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify the pricing record for sustainability and qualification details, while verifying onboarding evidence as the strongest alternative given the concurrent completion and activation decline.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment. Its source record showed higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (-2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), directly addressing the completion and activation declines with evidence consistent with sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing: verification found retention fell 12% despite near-term acquisition and revenue gains.
